title: docs: move x402 prepaid keys out of Get Started
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Moved x402 Prepaid Keys from Get Started to Resources, immediately after Account. Get Started now contains Quick Start and Authentication; existing documentation links and API endpoints are unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art reading nook, Polli moves an 'x402 Prepaid Keys' card from a Get Started shelf to a Resources shelf beside Account, with code-plants growing nearby. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and tiny librarian glasses; she is small within the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic with chunky retro sprites, a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, and lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
